title: Local Exact Controllability of Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert Equation
summary: We prove a local exact controllability result for controlled Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equations on $\mathbb T^2$: if the initial energy is sufficiently small, then for any terminal time $T>0$, there is a localised external magnetic field such that the system can be steered exactly to the terminal value of any nearby uncontrolled trajectory. We first transform the equation to a quasilinear parabolic system on $\mathbb R^2$ by a suitable stereographic chart.
